title: Mercedes Moné vs. Willow Nightingale
summary: Their AEW rivalry begins around the TBS title and returns with the Women’s World Championship at stake.

chapters.title: Moné takes the TBS title
chapters.result: Moné defeats Willow to win the TBS Championship.
chapters.context: Her first AEW match ends with championship gold.

chapters.title: Willow takes the title back
chapters.result: Willow defeats Moné for the TBS Championship.
chapters.context: The rematch reverses their first AEW championship result.

chapters.title: A different championship, the same rivals
chapters.result: Moné defeats Willow for the Women’s World Championship.
chapters.context: Their rivalry moves from the TBS title to AEW’s women’s world title.
